input.title: Enterprise Compute Initiative Opens Applications for AI Compute Credits
input.contentText: SINGAPORE, 20 January 2026 — The Enterprise Compute Initiative announced at Budget 2025 opened applications today. Eligible enterprises can access up to S$250,000 in credits to procure AI compute capacity and professional services from appointed cloud providers, including AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure. The S$150 million initiative targets companies deploying AI in production rather than experimentation, and complements the National Supercomputing Centre's research-focused allocations. IMDA said early demand has been strongest from precision manufacturing, logistics and financial services firms building custom AI applications.
